parameters.prompt: The exact brown bear warrior in the reference takes a defensive guard in place. From the resting pose it crouches low, hunches the armored shoulder forward and raises the armored forearm with the bracer in front of its face, then holds this braced guard very steadily with only slow breathing, then lowers the arm, straightens and calmly returns to the exact original standing pose and holds it. Both feet stay planted. Keep the exact strict side profile facing LEFT from the reference: head, muzzle, chest and feet point to the left edge, the face never turns toward the camera. Keep the same bear head, rounded ears, brown fur, shoulder armor, bracer, round belt buckle and leather kilt, same proportions. It stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Exactly two arms and two legs. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole body stays inside the frame with clear margins at all times. No turning toward the camera, attack, jumping, extra limbs, weapon, glow, energy, dust, rocks, cracks, particles, shadow or text. Motion beats: first second and a half crouch into the guard, hold the guard until three and a half seconds, then rise and hold the original pose.
